units.source_text: 女人的姿势放随便了，侧身坐在铺席上。

en.t: The woman had relaxed her posture and was sitting sideways on the mat.

units.source_text: 室内使用山大概是100瓦的电灯，在限制用电的情况下，这是鲜见的亮度。

en.t: The room was lit by what was probably a 100-watt electric bulb, a rare brightness under power restrictions.

units.source_text: 这才明晃晃地照亮了女人的身体。

en.t: Only then was the woman's body brightly illuminated.

units.source_text: 她系着的博多白绢制的名古屋腰带白得鲜明，友样丝绸和服上面的藤架霞的紫色浮现了出来。

en.t: The Hakata white silk Nagoya obi she wore stood out in vivid white, and the purple of the wisteria-trellis haze pattern on her Yuzen silk kimono came into view.
